description: EliteG19s: companion app for Elite Dangerous with Logitech LCD, web and VoiceAttack support.
notes: Needs the .NET 10 Desktop and ASP.NET Core runtimes (see suggest; both install machine-wide from an elevated shell).
Settings live in %AppData%\EliteG19s, outside the app folder.
This manifest tracks the developer's site, which is also the app's own update feed; GitHub releases lag behind it.
If EliteG19s offers an update on launch, decline it and run 'scoop update eliteg19s' instead; accepting installs a second copy
